title: From cash to credit, how Americans’ payment methods have changed in the past decade
summary_en: Since 2015, the share of Americans who say they use cash for all or almost all of their purchases in a typical week has fallen by half, from 24% to 12%.
title_cn: From cash to credit, how Americans’ payment methods have changed in the past decade

title: Can AI Stand In for Human Survey-Takers? Not Really
summary_en: Synthetic surveys using digital twins do a poor job estimating the public mood and are especially error-prone for some subgroups, including Republicans and Black adults.
title_cn: Can AI Stand In for Human Survey-Takers? Not Really
